title: Agentic Memory Entry Schema
description: Validation schema for semantic memory entries with lifecycle, confidence, source and TTL metadata.

id.description: Unique TypeID for the memory entry

scope.description: Component, technology or domain module affected

confidence.description: Empirical confidence level in this heuristic

source.description: Origin of the insight or heuristic

last_validated.description: Date when this heuristic was last empirically validated (YYYY-MM-DD)

expires_at.description: Optional TTL expiration date for volatile dependencies (YYYY-MM-DD)
